ActionInput_mailgun_listtemplates.description: Input for listing the stored message templates of a Mailgun domain.

name.description: Name of the template.

createdAt.description: Creation date of the template in RFC 2822 format. Example: "Wed, 29 Aug 2018 23:31:13 UTC".

createdBy.description: Identity of the user who created the template, when provided by Mailgun.

domain.description: Domain the template belongs to.

items.description: Stored templates of the domain for the requested page.

nextCursor.description: Pagination pivot for the next page, taken from the provider paging.next link. Pass it back as the cursor input; an empty items array marks the end of the list.

ActionOutput_mailgun_listtemplates.description: A page of stored Mailgun templates for a domain.

actions.description: List unsubscribe suppression entries for a Mailgun domain.
actions.name: list-unsubscribes

domain.description: Domain to list unsubscribe suppressions for. Example: "mg.example.com"

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return per page. Mailgun defaults to 100 and caps at 1000. Example: 100

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page, taken from next_cursor of a previous response. Omit for the first page.

ActionInput_mailgun_listunsubscribes.description: Input for listing unsubscribe suppression entries of a Mailgun domain.

address.description: Email address that is unsubscribed. Example: "alice@example.com"

tags.description: Tags of the message the recipient unsubscribed from. ["*"] means unsubscribed from all mail for the domain.

created_at.description: Timestamp of when the unsubscribe was recorded, in RFC 2822 format. Example: "Fri, 21 Oct 2011 06:02:36 GMT"

items.description: Unsubscribe suppression entries for the requested page. Empty when no (further) entries exist.

next_cursor.description: Cursor to pass as cursor input to fetch the next page. Absent when there is no next page.

ActionOutput_mailgun_listunsubscribes.description: A page of unsubscribe suppression entries for a Mailgun domain.

actions.description: List a domain's sending allowlist (whitelist) entries
actions.name: list-whitelist-entries

domain.description: The domain whose sending allowlist should be listed. Example: "mg.example.com"

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return (1-1000). Defaults to 100 when omitted

term.description: Optional prefix filter. Only entries whose address starts with this substring are returned

cursor.description: Full pagination URL returned as nextCursor by a previous call. When provided, domain, limit and term are ignored

ActionInput_mailgun_listwhitelistentries.description: Input for listing a domain's sending allowlist entries

value.description: The allowlisted address or domain. Example: "user@example.com"

type.description: Entry type: "address" for a single address or "domain" for an entire domain

reason.description: User-provided reason recorded when the entry was added. Omitted when no reason was given

createdAt.description: Timestamp for when the entry was created, in RFC 822 format. Example: "Tue, 12 Aug 2025 20:00:06 UTC"

items.description: Allowlist entries for the requested page. Empty when the domain has no allowlist entries

nextCursor.description: URL to pass as cursor to fetch the next page. Absent when there are no more pages

ActionOutput_mailgun_listwhitelistentrie.description: The domain's sending allowlist entries and pagination state

actions.description: Remove a member from a mailing list.
actions.name: remove-list-member

list_address.description: Email address of the mailing list the member belongs to. Example: "newsletter@mg.example.com".

member_address.description: Email address of the member to remove from the mailing list. Example: "jane.doe@example.com".

ActionInput_mailgun_removelistmember.description: Input for removing a member from a Mailgun mailing list.

address.description: Email address of the member that was removed from the mailing list.

message.description: Confirmation message returned by Mailgun. Example: "Mailing list member has been deleted".

ActionOutput_mailgun_removelistmember.description: Result of removing a member from a Mailgun mailing list.

actions.description: Checks a recipient against the domain's bounce, complaint, and unsubscribe suppression lists and only sends the message if the address is not suppressed.
actions.name: send-email-safely

domain.description: Mailgun domain whose suppression lists are checked and from which the message is sent. Example: "mg.example.com"

from.description: Sender address for the From header. Supports a friendly name. Example: "Alice <alice@mg.example.com>"

to.description: Recipient email address. This address is looked up on the domain's bounce, complaint, and unsubscribe suppression lists before any send is attempted. Example: "bob@example.com"

ActionInput_mailgun_sendemailsafely.description: Recipient, sender, and content for an email that is only sent after checking the recipient against the domain's suppression lists.

sent.description: True when Mailgun accepted the message and queued it for delivery

suppressed.description: True when the recipient was found on a suppression list, in which case no send was attempted

reason.description: Which suppression list the recipient was found on. Present only when suppressed is true

details.description: The suppression record that matched the recipient. Present only when suppressed is true

address.description: The suppressed email address. Example: "bob@example.com"

created_at.description: When the suppression record was created, in RFC 2822 format. Example: "Mon, 26 Oct 2020 10:00:00 GMT"

code.description: SMTP error code. Present on bounce records only. Example: "550"

error.description: SMTP error message. Present on bounce records only

tags.description: Tags of the message the recipient unsubscribed from. Present on unsubscribe records only

message_id.description: Mailgun message ID. Present only when sent is true. Example: "<20201016000000.1.abcdef@mg.example.com>"

message.description: Mailgun response message, e.g. "Queued. Thank you.". Present only when sent is true

error.description: Provider error when the send was attempted but Mailgun rejected it. Present only when sent is false and suppressed is false

status.description: HTTP status code returned by Mailgun for the rejected send. Example: 403

message.description: Error message returned by Mailgun for the rejected send

ActionOutput_mailgun_sendemailsafely.description: Outcome of the suppression check and, when the recipient is not suppressed, of the send attempt.

actions.description: Send an email message through a domain.
actions.name: send-message

domain.description: Mailgun domain used to send the message. Example: "mg.example.com". Sandbox domains reject every send with a 403; use a verified custom domain.

from.description: Email address of the From header. Supports a friendly name. Example: "Acme Billing <postmaster@mg.example.com>".

to.description: Email address of the recipient(s). Supports friendly names and comma-separated multiple recipients. Example: "Bob <bob@example.com>, alice@example.com".

text.description: Body of the message (text version). At least one of text or html must be provided.

html.description: Body of the message (HTML version). At least one of text or html must be provided.

cc.description: CC recipient address(es). Supports friendly names and comma-separated multiple recipients.

bcc.description: BCC recipient address(es). Supports friendly names and comma-separated multiple recipients.

ActionInput_mailgun_sendmessage.description: Input for sending an email message through a Mailgun domain.

id.description: Unique provider-assigned identifier of the queued message, in RFC-2392 format. Example: "<20261001.1.ABCDEF@mg.example.com>".

message.description: Provider status message for the send request. Example: "Queued. Thank you.".

ActionOutput_mailgun_sendmessage.description: Result returned by Mailgun once the message has been accepted and queued for delivery.

actions.description: Add a member to a mailing list, automatically creating the list first if it does not exist yet.
actions.name: subscribe-email-to-list

list_address.description: Email address of the mailing list to subscribe to, e.g. "newsletter@mg.example.com". The list is created automatically if it does not exist yet.

list_name.description: Name for the mailing list, used only when this call creates it. Defaults to the part of list_address before the "@".

access_level.description: Access level for the mailing list, used only when this call creates it. Defaults to "members" instead of Mailgun's own "readonly" default. Ignored when the list already exists.

member_address.description: Email address of the member to add to the list, e.g. "jane@example.com".

member_vars.description: Arbitrary JSON key/value data to store on the member, e.g. {"plan": "pro"}.

ActionInput_mailgun_subscribeemailtolist.description: Input for subscribing an email address to a Mailgun mailing list, creating the list first when it does not exist.

list_created.description: True when this call created the mailing list because it did not exist yet; false when the list already existed.

address.description: Email address of the member.

name.description: Display name of the member.

vars.description: Arbitrary JSON key/value data stored on the member.

subscribed.description: Whether the member is subscribed to the list.

member.description: The resulting mailing list member after the upsert.

ActionOutput_mailgun_subscribeemailtolis.description: Result of subscribing the email address: whether the list was created by this call, plus the final member.

actions.description: Update a mailing list member's subscription status, name, or custom variables.
actions.name: update-list-member

list_address.description: Email address of the mailing list containing the member. Example: "dev@samples.mailgun.org"

member_address.description: Email address of the list member to update. Example: "jane.doe@example.com"

name.description: New full name for the member. Omit to leave the current name unchanged.

subscribed.description: New subscription status for the member. Unsubscribed members remain on the list but are skipped when mail is sent to it. Omit to leave the current status unchanged.

vars.description: Custom variables to store on the member as a JSON object. Example: {"role": "admin"}. Omit to leave the current variables unchanged.

ActionInput_mailgun_updatelistmember.description: Fields identifying the mailing list member to update and the new values to apply. Only the provided fields are changed; omitted fields keep their current values.

address.description: Email address of the updated member.

name.description: Full name of the member. Omitted when the member has no name set.

subscribed.description: Whether the member is currently subscribed to the mailing list.

vars.description: Custom variables stored on the member. Omitted when the member has none.

ActionOutput_mailgun_updatelistmember.description: The mailing list member as stored on the provider after the update was applied.

actions.description: Update a template's metadata (description and/or name).
actions.name: update-template

domain.description: Domain the template belongs to. Example: "mg.example.com"

name.description: Current name of the template to update. Example: "welcome-email"

description.description: New description for the template. Example: "Welcome email for new signups"

new_name.description: New name for the template. When provided, the template is renamed. Example: "welcome-email-v2"

ActionInput_mailgun_updatetemplate.description: Input for updating a Mailgun template's metadata. Provide at least one of description or new_name.

name.description: Name of the template after the update. Differs from the input name when new_name was provided.

message.description: Confirmation message returned by Mailgun, e.g. "template has been updated" or "Template has been renamed".

ActionOutput_mailgun_updatetemplate.description: Result of the template metadata update.

syncs.description: Sync hard-bounce suppression entries, fanned out across all domains on the Mailgun account.
syncs.name: bounces

id.description: Unique identifier for the bounce suppression, composed as `{domain}/{address}` because the same address can be suppressed on multiple domains.

domain.description: The Mailgun sending domain this bounce suppression belongs to, e.g. "mg.example.com".

address.description: The recipient email address that hard-bounced and is now suppressed from further sending.

code.description: The SMTP error code returned by the recipient mail server, e.g. "550".

error.description: The human-readable error message returned by the recipient mail server, e.g. "5.1.1 The email account that you tried to reach does not exist".

created_at.description: When Mailgun recorded the bounce, in RFC 2822 format, e.g. "Fri, 02 Oct 2026 00:31:24 UTC".

Bounce.description: A Mailgun hard-bounce suppression entry for a single recipient address on a single sending domain.

syncs.description: Sync spam-complaint suppression entries, fanned out across all Mailgun domains on the connection
syncs.name: complaints

id.description: Stable record id scoped by domain in the form '{domain}/{address}'. The same address can be suppressed on multiple domains, so the domain prefix keeps ids unique.

domain.description: Mailgun domain this spam-complaint suppression belongs to (e.g. mg.example.com or a sandbox domain).

address.description: Email address that filed the spam complaint. Delivery to this address is suppressed for the domain.

created_at.description: When the complaint was recorded, in Mailgun's RFC 2822 timestamp format (e.g. 'Tue, 12 Aug 2025 20:00:06 UTC'). Omitted when Mailgun returns none.

Complaint.description: A Mailgun spam-complaint suppression entry for a single email address on a single domain.

syncs.description: Sync all sending domains on the Mailgun account.
syncs.name: domains

id.description: Unique Mailgun identifier of the domain. Example: "69aeedd584d39943e1a587f1"

name.description: Fully qualified domain name. Example: "mg.example.com"

type.description: Domain type: "custom" for a customer-added domain or "sandbox" for the Mailgun-provided test domain

created_at.description: Creation date of the domain as an RFC 2822 string. Example: "Mon, 09 Mar 2026 15:57:09 GMT"

smtp_login.description: Default SMTP login of the domain. Example: "postmaster@mg.example.com"

spam_action.description: How spam-filtered inbound mail is handled: "disabled", "block" or "tag"

wildcard.description: Whether wildcard subdomain sending is enabled for the domain

require_tls.description: Whether TLS is required when delivering messages for the domain

skip_verification.description: Whether DNS verification was skipped when the domain was added

is_disabled.description: Whether the domain is currently disabled

use_automatic_sender_security.description: Whether automatic sender security (managed DKIM/SPF keys) is enabled

web_prefix.description: Subdomain prefix used for open/click tracking links. Example: "email"

web_scheme.description: URL scheme used for tracking links: "http" or "https"

encrypt_incoming_message.description: Whether incoming messages are encrypted at rest

message_ttl.description: Time in seconds a stored message is retained before expiry. Example: 86400

Domain.description: A sending domain configured on the Mailgun account

syncs.description: Syncs Mailgun event log entries (accepted, delivered, failed, rejected, opened, clicked, complained, etc.) across all domains on the connection. Incremental via a per-domain timestamp high-watermark; only covers the Mailgun event retention window, not a permanent archive.
syncs.name: events

id.description: Unique record id in the form `${domain}:${event_id}` so ids cannot collide across domains.

event_id.description: Mailgun event GUID, unique within its domain, e.g. "0_j20QZ_TJ2iOoRwo0TK1A".

domain.description: The Mailgun sending domain this event belongs to, e.g. "mg.example.com".

event.description: Event type, e.g. accepted, delivered, failed, rejected, opened, clicked, complained, unsubscribed or stored.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch timestamp in seconds (float) when the event occurred, e.g. 1790875136.2817214.

recipient.description: Recipient email address the event relates to. Can be an empty string on some rejected events.

recipient_domain.description: Domain part of the recipient address, e.g. "example.com".

from.description: Sender address: the message From header when present, otherwise the envelope sender.

subject.description: Subject line of the message, when present on the event.

message_id.description: Mailgun message id from the Message-Id header, e.g. "20261001171855.a0270cd53d7ce72c@mg.example.com".

severity.description: Event severity for failed events, e.g. "permanent" or "temporary".

reason.description: Human-readable reason for failed or rejected events, when provided.

log_level.description: Mailgun log level for the event, e.g. "info", "warn" or "error".

method.description: How the message was submitted to Mailgun, e.g. "HTTP" or "SMTP"; can be empty.

ip.description: IP address that triggered an engagement event (opened/clicked), when present.

originating_ip.description: IP address of the sender that submitted the message to Mailgun, when present.

sending_ip.description: Mailgun IP address used to deliver the message, when present.

tags.description: User-defined tags attached to the message.

items.description: A user-defined tag attached to the message.

storage_url.description: URL of the stored message in Mailgun storage, when the message was stored.

delivery_status.description: Delivery status details; present mainly on delivered and failed events.

code.description: SMTP response code returned by the receiving server, e.g. 250.

message.description: Full SMTP response message returned by the receiving server.

mx_host.description: Hostname of the receiving MX server, e.g. "aspmx.l.google.com".

mx_host_ip.description: IP address of the receiving MX server.

session_seconds.description: Duration of the SMTP delivery session in seconds (float).

first_delivery_attempt_seconds.description: Seconds between message acceptance and the first delivery attempt (float).

tls.description: Whether TLS was negotiated with the receiving server.

certificate_verified.description: Whether the receiving server certificate was verified.

Event.description: A Mailgun event log entry (delivery, engagement or suppression event) for a message, normalized across all domains on the connection.

syncs.description: Sync members across all Mailgun mailing lists: enumerate every mailing list, then fetch every member of each list tagged with its parent list address
syncs.name: list-members

id.description: Stable unique record id composed as "<list_address>/<member_address>", because a member address is only unique within its parent mailing list

list_address.description: Address of the parent mailing list this member belongs to, e.g. "announce@example.com"

address.description: Email address of the mailing list member, e.g. "jane@example.com"

name.description: Display name of the member as stored by Mailgun (empty string when never provided)

subscribed.description: Whether the member is currently subscribed to the mailing list; false means unsubscribed but still on the list

vars.description: Custom JSON variables attached to the member, keyed by variable name, e.g. { "phone": "+972559221288" }

ListMember.description: A member of a Mailgun mailing list, tagged with the address of its parent list

syncs.description: Sync mailing lists on the account.
syncs.name: lists

id.description: Unique record identifier. Same value as the mailing list address, which Mailgun uses as the list ID (e.g. "newsletter@example.com").

address.description: Email address that identifies the mailing list (e.g. "newsletter@example.com").

name.description: Human-readable name of the mailing list.

description.description: Description of the mailing list. Empty string when none is set.

access_level.description: Who can post to the list: "readonly", "members", or "everyone".

reply_preference.description: Where replies to list messages are sent: "list" or "sender". Omitted when the list has no explicit preference stored.

members_count.description: Number of subscribed members on the mailing list.

created_at.description: List creation timestamp in RFC 5322 format as returned by Mailgun (e.g. "Tue, 15 Sep 2026 16:29:03 -0000").

MailingList.description: A Mailgun mailing list on the account.

syncs.description: Syncs stored message templates, fanned out across all Mailgun domains on the account
syncs.name: templates

id.description: Stable record ID scoped across the domain fan-out: "{domain}/{Mailgun template ID}". Example: "mg.example.com/01a0f9ff-cdfb-764d-97d6-483199890cb4"

name.description: Template name, unique within its domain and used to address the template in the Mailgun API. Example: "welcome-email"

description.description: Human-readable template description. Omitted when Mailgun returns none or null.

createdAt.description: Template creation date in RFC 2822 format as returned by Mailgun. Example: "Fri, 02 Oct 2026 00:24:46 UTC"

domain.description: Mailgun sending domain that owns the template. Example: "mg.example.com"

Template.description: A stored Mailgun message template. The list endpoint returns metadata only - version/body content is not included.

syncs.description: Sync domain-wide unsubscribe suppression entries, fanned out across all Mailgun domains
syncs.name: unsubscribes

id.description: Stable record id scoped to the sending domain, formatted as `{domain}/{address}` (e.g. `mg.example.com/user@example.com`). The same address can be unsubscribed in multiple domains, so the domain is part of the id.

address.description: Email address that is suppressed from receiving email, e.g. `user@example.com`

domain.description: Sending domain this unsubscribe entry belongs to, e.g. `mg.example.com`

tags.description: Tags the unsubscribe applies to. The default `["*"]` means the address is unsubscribed from all tags/campaigns of the domain.

created_at.description: RFC 2822 timestamp of when the address was unsubscribed, e.g. `Fri, 02 Oct 2026 01:07:33 UTC`

Unsubscribe.description: A Mailgun unsubscribe suppression entry for a sending domain
